key_risk: October core PCE tonight (20:30 ICT; consensus 0.3% m/m, 3.2% y/y, some at 3.4%) is the last inflation print before the 9 Dec FOMC, with a hike ~96% priced. A soft print can't add much; a 0.4% would push the 2y back above 4.70% and DXY through 104.5, putting USDTHB through 34.00. US markets are closed Thursday, so liquidity thins fast after the 7y auction.
